infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Tappd uses your location to show events happening near you and help you discover local experiences.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Tappd needs access to your photos so you can upload profile pictures, share event photos, and post updates with images.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Tappd needs camera access so you can take photos for your profile, events, and posts directly within the app.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Tappd needs microphone access so you can record videos with audio for your posts and event shares.
